_doc: Who each person of the prison is: name -> {traits (ids of assets/data/traits.json), bio (one line)}. Read by prison_arc.gd `traits_of` and `bio_of`; the traits an event adds later are in arc.person_traits and come on top of these. Everyone in the roster, the clear-phase allies and the pool of survivors that raids find (prison_raids.json `people`) is here.

Cole.bio: Held a checkpoint on the east road until the road stopped leading anywhere.

Bea.bio: Hunted rabbits with her father. Does not like to wait for a clean shot.

Ike.bio: Drove a delivery van. Knows which back doors are never locked.

Walt.bio: Thirty years on a prison gate. The dead are not the worst thing he has watched come up a road.

Dez.bio: A hunting-club marksman who never shot at anything that shot back, until now.

Rae.bio: A night nurse. Hears the wall in her sleep.

Sol.bio: Used to repair watches. Reloads like he is setting a spring.

Mia.bio: Ran a canteen. Says the soup is better tomorrow, and mostly it is.

Marcus.bio: A groundsman with a bad knee and a worse temper for weeds.

Nia.bio: Seventeen. Learned to garden from a library book, in a week.

Ana.bio: An ambulance medic. Decides who is first without looking up.

Hector.bio: Kept the prison's generator alive for nine years on tape and bad language.

Tomas.bio: A fence contractor. Does not trust any wall he did not build, and trusts his friends too much.

Owen.bio: A hauler who never came back from a job with an empty truck.

June.bio: A courier on a motorbike. Has never once waited for the lights.

Kit.bio: Eight years old. Thinks the radio voice is a friend.

Pip.bio: Seven. Repeats everything the grown-ups say, in the same voice.

Ivo.bio: A mechanic who was fired twice for tools going missing. Both times the tools were in his van.

Lena.bio: A pharmacy technician. Counts tablets out loud when she is frightened.

Pavel.bio: A market gardener. Put his rifle down on the first day and has not picked it up.

Greta.bio: A school cook. Won't carry a gun, will carry a fifty-litre pot.

Samir.bio: A bus driver. Brave on the road, not on a tower.

Rosa.bio: A removal woman. Can carry a wardrobe and can smell a full larder.

Teo.bio: A clay-pigeon champion at nineteen. Likes the numbers on the wall.

Nell.bio: A hospice nurse. Has sat with a great many people at the end and is not afraid of it.

Abel.bio: A farmhand. Was bitten once in the first week and says it was only a dog.

Vera.bio: A locksmith. There is no key she does not wish to try.

Jonas.bio: A reservist sergeant. Counts the exits first, then the people.

Maren.bio: A ferry cook. Will go back for anyone, and has.
